observations.statement: TEST: SSH from the owner Windows machine to the VPS as deploy (command: ssh deploy@51.68.226.211, ED25519 public-key authentication). RESULT: successful login. Verified 2026-08-19.
TEST: SCP file transfer from the owner Windows machine to the VPS as deploy (command: scp <file> deploy@51.68.226.211:<path>). RESULT: successful transfer. Verified 2026-08-19.

TEST: from the Mythos AI execution environment (sandboxed remote session, 2026-08-19): TCP probe to 51.68.226.211 port 22 (command: bash /dev/tcp probe with 12s timeout) RESULT: unreachable; ssh/scp/rsync binaries absent; no key material present. AI-agent to VPS access is NOT available from this execution environment.

facts.statement: VERIFIED FACT: the Mythos production VPS is 51.68.226.211.
VERIFIED FACT: the deployment account on the VPS is 'deploy'; it exists and accepts SSH public-key authentication (key type ED25519).
VERIFIED FACT: SSH from the owner Windows machine to the VPS as deploy was verified successful on 2026-08-19; the previous deploy-user SSH blocker is resolved for the owner machine.
VERIFIED FACT: SCP from the owner Windows machine to the VPS was verified successful on 2026-08-19; the owner-machine-to-VPS deployment SSH channel is usable.
VERIFIED FACT: rsync is installed on the VPS.
VERIFIED FACT: rsync is currently NOT available on the owner Windows machine; transfers from Windows use scp or tar-over-ssh instead.

CAPABILITY LIMITATION: successful owner-machine SSH/SCP access MUST NOT be interpreted as proof that the Mythos AI Operating Layer can access the VPS. Owner-machine access and AI-agent infrastructure access are separate facts. AI-agent to VPS access remains unverified/unavailable until directly tested from the actual AI execution environment; the 2026-08-19 test from a sandboxed session found no transport (see evidence).

NON-STORABLE SECRET policy: private SSH keys, key contents, passwords, tokens and credentials are never stored in OTH Knowledge; only non-secret metadata is recorded (key type, purpose, verification date, test command, test result, fingerprint where appropriate).
